content: Open-source digest/weekly-summary CLI space has converged on a clear feature set: (1) rolling lookback window flag (--since/--until or days=7), (2) configurable LLM provider+model with pluggable backends (Anthropic, OpenAI, Gemini), (3) prompt customization per voice/audience (evoleinik/changelog-summary explicitly ships developer/founder/marketing voice styles — closest analog to dual-audience reporting), (4) PAT auth via env, (5) GitLab MRs+issues+commits fetched via REST v4 with --since filter, (6) Markdown output to local dir, (7) optional cache+retry+parallel-fetch for resilience. Reference analogs inspected: bzz/weekly-digest-cli (Node, GitHub-only), abensur/github-activity-digest (Bun, multi-org, Anthropic+OpenAI), sahansera/gh-weekly-updates (Python, single-audience engineering), yinzhenyu-su/weekly-git-summary (cross-platform CLI). Commercial space (LaunchNotes, ReleaseNotes.io, GitHub auto release notes, Release Please, GitClear, Beamer, Headway, LogRocket Galileo, Conventional Changelog, ChangeCrab) splits into customer-facing SaaS (LaunchNotes, Beamer, Headway) and developer-centric automation (Release Please, Conventional Changelog); engineering-intelligence analytics (Swarmia, LinearB, Jellyfish, Waydev) target DORA metrics, not narrative digests. SmartNote arxiv 2505.17977 confirms dual-audience framing has research backing. None of the inspected tools do ONE fetch → TWO audiencially distinct Markdown files for self-hosted GitLab via PAT; that combination is the gap our tool fills.
